facts.fact: The government says work begun on 5 May 2026 under the Gabon Digital programme aims to modernise the cadastre and structure land data, and a 14 September 2026 session with SNEDAI continued it on digitalising land tenure.
The digital economy minister said on 30 November 2025 that the digitalisation of cadastral processes is under way, and called for a digital cadastre attesting ownership through an accessible map.

facts.fact: We Are Tech reports Gabon is advancing a land-registry digitisation project with the Ivorian group SNEDAI after signing a memorandum of understanding, with a pilot planned in Estuaire province including Greater Libreville and specifications still to be finalised.

The housing minister's site reports a land digitisation protocol was signed with SNEDAI on 14 September 2026 for a system centralising cadastral data, with a pilot envisaged in the Estuaire, and works on the first lots were being accelerated in October 2026.
